full_prompt_en: A square, highly textured fantasy landscape painting shows an old steep-roofed house set against a rocky hill beneath immense storm clouds. The sky occupies well over half the frame, crowded with towering cream, slate-blue, charcoal, and violet cloud masses. Warm light catches the billowing upper folds, while dark lower layers gather around the hill and distant horizon. The house stands near the center, small beneath a tall crag that rises immediately behind its roof. Its gables, porch, and stacked windows are carefully outlined, with amber interior lights glowing from selected openings. Low trees and shrubbery partly wrap the building, blending its base into the stone slope. A winding dirt path starts near the lower edge and curves toward the house, passing coarse grass, scattered rocks, and sparse bushes. To the right, a distant pale mountain appears through the cloud breaks; to the left, the land flattens toward a low horizon. Small colored circular objects or lights hover among the clouds at either side, adding a faintly uncanny note without dominating the landscape. The rocks and foreground earth are rendered with short, rugged brush marks and granular detail, whereas the distant terrain loses definition in atmospheric haze. Light seems to come from a low warm opening in the clouds, grazing the cloud tops, path, and rock faces; the house windows add a second localized amber glow. Deep blue and purple shadows give the sky weight while the warm windows make the building feel inhabited. The overall composition uses a small lit structure and winding approach to anchor a huge theatrical sky, creating a mysterious, storybook sense of scale.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、纹理丰富的奇幻风景画呈现一栋陡顶旧屋坐落在岩石山丘前，头顶翻涌着巨大的暴风云。天空占据远超半幅画面，挤满奶油色、板岩蓝、炭黑和紫色的高耸云团。暖光照到鼓起的上层云褶，深暗下层则聚在山丘与远地平线周围。房屋接近中央，在紧贴屋顶后方升起的高峭岩峰下显得很小。山墙、门廊和层叠窗户轮廓细致，选定的窗口透出琥珀色室内灯光。低树与灌木局部包住房屋，使底部融入石坡。一条弯曲土路从下缘附近开始，经过粗草、散石和稀疏灌丛，通向房屋。右侧，远处浅色山体从云隙中显现；左侧地势放平，延至较低的地平线。小小彩色圆形物或光点悬在两侧云间，加入轻微奇异气息，却不主宰地景。岩石和前景土面以短促粗犷笔迹与颗粒细节描出，远处地形则在空气雾感中失去定义。光仿佛来自云中较低的暖色开口，掠过云顶、小路与岩面；屋内窗灯又提供第二处局部琥珀亮光。深蓝与紫色阴影让天空沉重，暖窗则使房屋有居住气息。整体构图以小小亮屋和蜿蜒通路稳住巨大的戏剧性天空，形成神秘的绘本式尺度感。
style_prompt_en: The painting builds a vast sky from dense billowing masses and places a comparatively small, precise focal structure below it. Rugged short marks, granular rock texture, and finely articulated edges contrast with softer atmospheric distance. Deep blue, charcoal, and violet occupy the shadowed bulk; cream and peach light strike selected upper folds, while tiny amber points gather low. A winding path-like line can lead from a coarse foreground toward the compact center. Low warm directional light creates volume in clouds and stone, and small localized glows add human scale. The overall treatment is ornate, dramatic, and storybook-like without losing landscape depth.
style_prompt_zh: 画面以密集翻涌的团块建立浩大天空，在其下安放相对微小而精确的焦点结构。粗犷短笔、颗粒岩石肌理和细致边缘同较柔的空气远景对照。深蓝、炭黑与紫色占据背阴主体，奶油与桃色光打在选定上层褶皱，微小琥珀亮点聚在下方。一条蜿蜒路径般的线可把粗糙前景引向紧凑中心。偏低的暖定向光在云与石上塑造体积，小片局部亮光提供人类尺度。整体处理繁复、戏剧化且有绘本感，同时保留地景纵深。
theme_en: A glowing old house beneath immense storm clouds
theme_zh: 巨大的暴风云下，一栋亮着灯的老房子
name: Jim Hansel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
